modal.title: Add new location
modal.description: Fill in the details below to add a new parking location.

addressFailed.title: Address lookup failed
addressFailed.description: We could not determine the address for this location. Try moving the pin slightly.

orientation.title: Type of parking space

success.title: Thank you!
